- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: lines 186 and 190
  Problem: The runtime copy of implement-plan-claude.md routes every non-zero exit code from git diff --quiet into step 3 as detected drift, and line 190 treats any non-zero exit on the default check re-run as staleness. It lacks the template twin's update distinguishing exit 1 (drift detected) from comparison failures greater than 1 (such as exit 128 for missing merge base or invalid revision).
  Why it fails at runtime: Sessions reading .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md execute from this runtime copy. On an "Any other base" PR head where the default check exits 128 (e.g. no merge base in a shallow clone or diverged history), the comparison failure is misclassified as drift and recorded as claude_assets=stale (base <base>), allowing the session to continue executing under outdated .claude/ guards instead of halting with the caller's blocker.
